profile_description: 2D Pilot Line: all informations to the appearance
profile_sections:
Company profile: The 2D Pilot Line (2D-PL) enables companies to prototype and validate next-generation devices using graphene and related 2D materials – within industry-standard semiconductor processes. This EU-funded project provides end-to-end prototyping services for integrating graphene and transition metal dichalcogenides (TMDCs) into established silicon platforms. The focus is clear: move 2D materials from R&D to fab-ready technologies. Through process design kits and multi-project wafer (MPW) runs, customers can test their designs on shared wafers – reducing cost, lowering risk and accelerating development cycles. Applications span photonics, electronics and sensing, supporting use cases from high-speed data to advanced detection technologies.

Company profile: Since 1992, the 3-D MID e.V. research association has been connecting industry and academia in the field of Mechatronic Integrated Devices—the integration of electrical, mechanical, thermal, optical, sensory, and actuator functions into three-dimensional components. Company profile: Advanced Dicing Technologies (ADT) is a world leading manufacturer of comprehensive solutions for complexed dicing applications in the semiconductor, microelectronic and optical components industries, with over 40 years of experience. ADT Dicing saw lines offer a variety of capabilities, configurations, and levels of automation, as well as unique solutions for special applications. In addition, ADT offers dicing peripheral equipment and accessories, such as wafer cleaning system, water recycling system, spindle water chiller, semi-auto wafer mounting and more. ADT's high quality dicing blades range includes resin, metal sintered, nickel and hub blades. Supporting the ever-growing customer requirements, ADT's blades are the perfect dicing solution for various materials and substrates, such as: QFN & BGA packages, ceramics, glass and more.
